complexity_scale.definition: Ordinal implementation-complexity score for migrating the family's configurable fields to registry-managed typed records. Rule-based so it can be audited; it measures engineering/decision burden, NOT security value or customer value. Label: REASONED INFERENCE (lane D's own scale; not an R07 construct).

levels.1: At most 3 fields; one component; composition definable (set/min) and bounded differential evidence already exists (S05 for F1a).
levels.2: At most 5 fields; one component; composition definable without any open decision; no differential evidence yet.
levels.3: Typed non-set payload, scattered literals, or a must-agree pair across two components; composition definable per scalar below a code floor; no open critical decision (only low-priority classification).
levels.4: Composition conditional on an unruled decision (D4/D5/D6/D12, or a critical D1 row) OR cross-component binding is required OR a Tier 1 UNRESOLVED S02 row sits on the family.
levels.5: Composition not definable under current evidence (new semantics or a security-weakening mode) OR two or more independent level-4 triggers across components.
